text: A volunteer group is a promise nobody signed.
context: first interview, asked why the book

text: People don't quit the work. They quit the feeling that nobody would notice if they stopped.
A founder stepping down is like a company's founder leaving: the club has to find out it was never one person.
context: while looking at the empty cells in the coverage grid

text: We are still in the research phase. Stop giving me chapter titles.
context: after the agent proposed a spine on day one

text: The thank-you only counts if it costs the person saying it something.
Our choir lost six people the year we stopped the tea break.
context: fictional anecdote; needs a date before print
